status: Prototype vocabulary; requires review with participating doctors
principle: Record visible morphology on this H&E section. Patterns may coexist; these assessments do not establish a patient diagnosis.

findings.label: Internal nuclei
findings.help: Nuclei located inside muscle fibers, away from the edge.

findings.label: Fibrosis / fat replacement
findings.help: Muscle replaced by fibrous tissue or fat cells (adipocytes).

findings.label: Grouped atrophy
findings.help: Groups of small, atrophic muscle fibers.

coordinates: Evidence rectangles use level-0 pixels of the full original slide, with origin at top-left. No bounds cropping or rotation.
change_note: Simpler display labels; stable finding IDs and meanings. Confidence defaults to high for new reviews and when editing legacy reviews without confidence. Original revisions remain unchanged.
